intended_object: This is a block of raw data for a computer-checked certificate: an array of `NodeClaim` records giving the coverage claims for branch (5, 4), group 01, in the case analysis for the Erdős #97 convex octagon problem. I inferred this from the docstring, the name and the module (`CoverageCertificateData07`).
explanation: The body is just a hard-coded literal: an array of `NodeClaim` structures filled with bitmask-like natural numbers and index lists. A decision procedure uses it to check case coverage. It is an internal device of the proof by computation and has no counterpart in the mathematical literature. Its only role is to make the certificate check go through, so there is nothing to compare against a standard mathematical definition.
